title: One Promise and Thirty Winters
subtitle: 承诺与责任 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 承诺与责任（人与自我·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：承诺与责任（人与自我·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：commitment　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 commitment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my grandfather ① made a commitment he could not write down, and he said the making was the whole of the matter. The ② commitment, meaning the promise and not the wish, was given to a man who never asked again; commitment, he said, is the only thing between two people that is judged by how little it is repeated.

Every ③ commitment in that family had the same weight, and the ④ commitment at the end, meaning the one he kept for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever spoke of twice. Commitment, my grandmother said, is nine parts keeping and one part somebody willing to be there; my grandfather said the keeping is the part that outlasts the winter.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ commitment was the whole of the evening class, meaning the hours and not the promise. The ⑥ commitment, meaning the hours and not any of that, is the only thing in a class that everybody gives and nobody counts; commitment, she said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a promise and a set of hours. He said the hours are the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ commitment had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about whether it had been kept. The ⑧ commitment of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in February, was one promise and thirty years of winters; commitment, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to be there. She said the being there was never mentioned.

The ⑨ commitment I remember is the one at the end, which was made in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ commitment, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being kept; every commitment, she said, is a set of hours that has agreed to look like a promise. She said the hours were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 承诺（指那一句承诺本身，与那些意愿相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a commitment 作出承诺
D. n. 承诺（指那个家族里每一条）
E. n. 承诺（指末尾那一条）
F. n. 投入；奉献（时间与精力的投入）
G. n. 承诺（指报告里提到的那一条）
H. n. 责任；担当（抽象总称）

items.q: made a commitment he could not write down
The commitment, meaning the promise and not the wish
commitment was the whole of the evening class
the commitment had become a line in a report
The commitment of the whole thing
A commitment, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: make a commitment 意为“作出承诺”，1962 年祖父作出了一个他无法写下来的承诺。
commitment 意为“承诺”，指那一句承诺本身而不是那些意愿，它给了一个再没开口问过的人。
commitment 指那个家族里每一条承诺，每一条都有同样的分量。
commitment 指末尾那一条（他留给冬天的那一条），是唯一有人提起过两次的。
commitment 意为“投入、奉献”，母亲说投入就是那个夜校的全部，指的是那些小时而不是那句承诺。
commitment 为抽象用法，指时间与精力的投入，是课堂上人人都付出、却没人计算的东西。
commitment 意为“承诺”，指报告里提到的那一条，到 1970 年这条承诺成了报告里的一行。
commitment 意为“责任、担当”，祖父二月写道，整件事的担当是一句承诺三十个冬天。
commitment 意为“承诺”，我记得的是末尾那一条，1976 年作出，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
commitment 为抽象总称，祖母说一条承诺是唯一会因为被守住而变好的东西。
